findings.detail: The extracted fund-quarter fair value is 0.036 million below the SOI grand total before cash equivalents; the SOI includes a 0.034 million preferred-equity position in the same residual neighborhood.

rationale: B01 failed because only 132 of 139 leaf rows carried fair_value. The raw SOI is readable and gives a schedule fair-value grand total before cash equivalents of 1,493.627 million, while the flagged extract reports fund_quarter_fv_m of 1,493.591 million. That 0.036 million shortfall means the check is not merely a threshold artifact. The SOI structure also shows a 0.034 million preferred-equity row and preferred-equity contribution to the grand total, indicating a small investment fair-value extraction gap rather than source ambiguity.
